notes:
Faster start: the featured banner shows much sooner after the first launch, because StreamMate keeps what it learns about your guide between launches.

Up next can appear 30 seconds to 5 minutes before a show ends (Settings > Playback and audio), counts the last minute down in seconds, and OK dismisses it.

Tablets and unfolded foldables use the TV's big-screen layout: the featured title at the top of Home, Movies and Shows, what's playing under it, and rows of tiles.

On TVs, holding a button no longer also presses it when you let go, Recordings' buttons can be reached with the remote, followed games on Home use the smaller tiles, and Backspace and Green in full screen show your groups over the video.
